svg.title: Autocomplete latency by query class
svg.desc: p1: sift 0.17, sift (positions off) 0.18, Elasticsearch 0.30, pg_search 0.50, pg_textsearch 186, rum 19.79, pgx-bm25 4.59; p2: sift 0.20, sift (positions off) 0.20, Elasticsearch 0.28, pg_search 0.56, pg_textsearch 84.13, rum 4.42, pgx-bm25 1.15; p3: sift 0.16, sift (positions off) 0.17, Elasticsearch 0.25, pg_search 0.60, pg_textsearch 13.34, rum 2.58, pgx-bm25 36.57; p4: sift 0.17, sift (positions off) 0.16, Elasticsearch 0.21, pg_search 0.63, pg_textsearch 3.17, rum 0.40, pgx-bm25 3.08; w1: sift 0.15, sift (positions off) 0.15, Elasticsearch 0.18, pg_search 0.70, pg_textsearch 2.67, rum 0.24, pgx-bm25 1.50; a2: sift 0.17, sift (positions off) 0.16, Elasticsearch 0.18, pg_search 0.84, pg_textsearch 2.66, rum 4.03, pgx-bm25 2.22; a2s: sift 0.16, sift (positions off) 0.16, Elasticsearch 0.18, pg_search 0.78, pg_textsearch 2.72, rum 10.12, pgx-bm25 4.44; a3: sift 0.18, sift (positions off) 0.18, Elasticsearch 0.25, pg_search 1.25, pg_textsearch 2.74, rum 3.69, pgx-bm25 5.15; x2: sift 0.16, sift (positions off) 0.17, Elasticsearch 0.20, pg_search 0.94, pg_textsearch 2.72, rum 2.70, pgx-bm25 3.74
svg.text: p50 milliseconds, logarithmic axis, lower is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP, edge n-grams of the typed words expanded by the client.
pg_textsearch: emulation (edge n-gram text, it has no native prefix scoring), see docs/BENCHMARKS.md.
p1-p4: 1-4 letter prefix; w1: whole word; a2, a2s: word + 2 or 1 letter prefix; a3, x2: 3 or 2 prefixes
GeoNames cities15000, 34,165 places, top-20, 1 client, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 4-5); Oct 2026.
